data.desc: Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM) is a New York-based global alternative asset manager with deep experience across credit, real estate, and other alternative strategies. The firm pairs institutional expertise with an entrepreneurial culture that looks for opportunity early and pursues it with discipline. Rithm combines an asset management platform with a family of operating companies, giving it direct insight into many of the markets in which it invests. That owner-operator approach is built to deliver enduring performance for clients, partners, and shareholders.
